get_character.description: Get one Attack on Titan character by id, or by the link another record gives for them (a titan's current inheritor, say).
get_character.name: get_character

parameters.description: Pick a character, or use one from an earlier step by its id or by its link, such as a titan's current inheritor.
parameters.name: character_id

character.description: One character, and everything the API records about them.

age.description: The character's age in years, or 'unknown'.

alias.description: Other names the character goes by, such as 'Attack Titan'.

birthplace.description: Where the character was born, or 'unknown'.

episodes.description: Links to every episode the character appears in. Get several episodes takes this list as it is.

groups.description: The groups the character belongs to.

sub_groups.description: The parts of it the character is in, for example 'Special Operations Squad'.

height.description: The character's height as the API writes it, for example '15 m (Titan form)', or 'unknown'.

id.description: The record's id, which its Get action takes.

img.description: A link to the character's picture on the Attack on Titan fan wiki. Missing for the few characters the API has no picture of.

name.description: The character's name, for example 'Eren Jaeger'.

occupation.description: The character's occupation, for example 'Soldier', or 'unknown'.

relatives.description: The families the character belongs to.

family.description: The family's name, for example 'Jaeger family'.

members.description: Its members: links to characters, which Get several characters takes as they are, mixed with names of relatives the API has no record of, such as 'Unnamed mother'.

residence.description: Where the character lives, for example 'Wall Rose'.

roles.description: Roles the character has held, for example 'Scout Regiment Commanders'. Occasionally holds an empty entry.

species.description: What the character is, for example 'Human' and 'Intelligent Titan'.

get_characters.description: Get several Attack on Titan characters in one step, by id or link. Pass an episode's characters, an organization's members or a titan's former inheritors to turn their links into full characters. Entries that aren't a character, such as a titan's link, are skipped and listed, and ids no character has are listed in missing_ids.

list_characters.description: List Attack on Titan characters, 20 to a page, optionally filtered by name, gender, status or occupation. Each character comes with their aliases, species, age, height, birthplace, residence, relatives, groups, roles and the episodes they appear in.

parameters.description: Only characters whose name contains this, in any case (for example, jaeger finds all six Jaegers).
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Only characters of this gender.
parameters.name: gender

parameters.description: Only characters who are alive, deceased or unknown.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only characters with exactly this occupation, in any case (for example, soldier, warrior or thug).
parameters.name: occupation

parameters.description: Which page of 20 to return, starting at 1. Leave empty for the first page. A page past the last one returns no results, but still gives the real count and number of pages.
parameters.name: page

characters.description: One page of the characters that match, with how many match in all.

info.description: How many records match, and where this page sits among them.

count.description: How many match the filters in all, across every page.

next_page.description: A link to the next page, or null on the last page. Page takes the page number, not this link.

pages.description: How many pages of up to 20 the matches fill.

prev_page.description: A link to the previous page, or null on the first page and past the last one.

results.description: Up to 20 characters, in id order. Empty when nothing matches or the page is past the last one.

description: Look up Attack on Titan data using the free, keyless Attack on Titan API: browse and filter characters, episodes, locations, organizations and the Nine Titans, fetch any record by id or by the links records carry, and turn a list of those links into full characters or episodes in one step. No account or API key required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration with the community-run Attack on Titan API (attackontitanapi.com).
